comment: Broad sound classes for deciding whether a target sound was attempted. Read by web/src/engine/soundMatch.js and pronunciation/sound_match.py; both are pinned to tests/fixtures/sound_match_cases.json. Any vowel counts for any vowel. Two consonants count for each other when they share a group. The groups are common accent substitutions (think/tink/sink/fink, this/dis/zis, final devoicing, ship/sip, chair/share, sing/sin). V~W and L~R were added to the original list.
